name: Hue Bridge (US)

radios.note: Zigbee for lights and accessories; the buying guide table lists Ethernet for the V2 bridge.

matter.note: Philips says the square bridge gained Matter by software update; CSA lists a 'Hue Bridge Matter Platform' software certificate (firmware 1.4.2). Transport is Ethernet because the V2 bridge connects by cable. The Hue Bridge Pro is the newer model.

apple_home.note: Product page lists Apple Home; Matter also works. Philips excludes the Play HDMI Sync Box and the Tap dial's dial from Matter.

smartthings.note: Listed on the Hue Bridge product page as working with Samsung SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant has its own Philips Hue integration; its Matter docs say bridging Hue through Matter gains nothing.

hubRequired.note: Not applicable to the hub itself; not assessed.

localControl.note: Not confirmed from an official source.

deviceProtocols.note: Zigbee network private to Hue lights and accessories, separate from Wi-Fi.

matterBridge.note: Hue products on the bridge work with Matter, except the Play HDMI Sync Box and the Tap dial's dial; Bluetooth-connected products can't. Philips' buying-guide table lists Matter only for the Bridge Pro: verifier to reconcile.

threadBorderRouter.note: No Thread claim found for the V2 bridge.

maxDevices.note: Maker states 50 lights and 12 accessories, two separate limits, so no single number is recorded. The Bridge Pro supports more.

summary: Placeholder summary pending the editor: this record lists what the hub connects to and which ecosystems see those devices. Philips Hue bridge V2, a Zigbee bridge for Hue lights and accessories.
